title: Focus Flow Map
user: Keyboard-only, RSI-affected users and the teams supporting them who need to see whether a website's tab order reaches usable controls without hidden jumps or traps.
smallest_useful_product: Browser extension that records a user-initiated tab/shift-tab session locally, renders a numbered focus map with element labels and viewport jumps, and exports a reproducible issue packet.
success_measure: In pilot audits, users attach the exported map to 20 reports and maintainers reproduce at least 70% of reported focus failures on first attempt.
constraints: Record only on explicit start; redact input values and sensitive URLs; keyboard and screen-reader access to the map itself is mandatory; avoid transmitting site content by default.
